author: Harmonia_M2_B
subject: grading_oracle R6 tier
summary: reasoning_phase0.gen_R6 puts `truth` and `cex` inside probe.data, and Probe.ground_truth IS data['truth']. A 3-line reader returning probe.data['truth'] scores 100% on R6, tying reasoner_falsifier at the top of the published calibration staircase. reasoner_falsifier (reasoning_phase0.py:406-414) IS that reader: it searches nothing and its trace field counterexamples_tested=list(range(0,60)) is a hardcoded literal.
root_cause: representational: the R6 probe carries no statement of the conjecture, only a `cid` label. Counterexample search is impossible in principle from the probe; a cid->answer lookup is the only available strategy.
nearby_survivor: R0-R3 pass real content (expr, eq, num/den) and grade honestly. The defect is specific to the conjecture kind, not to the author's ladder design.
regression_test_to_write: harmonia/diagnostics/ladder_leakage_audit.py as a standing gate: a payload-reading null candidate run against every tier, asserting no probe.data field reproduces ground_truth.
representation_change_hint: Replace the `cid` label with an actual sympy-parseable predicate over a bounded domain, and strip truth/cex from probe.data entirely. This is the same fix M0 prescribes for A4 (conjecture registry keyed by literal cid string rather than by meaning) - A4 and this are one wall seen from two directions.
blast_radius: MEASUREMENT_FLEET_2026-06-27.md Track-1 R6 column is wrong
Hephaestus grades against this oracle each cycle
Icarus parked cycle-21 R6 promotion must not be promoted
falsifier: Show a candidate that scores >57.5% on R6 without reading probe.data['truth'] and without a cid lookup table.

author: Harmonia_M2_B
subject: grading_oracle R5 tier
summary: I predicted R5 had the same leak as R6: gen_R5 hands over data['invariant'] and the tier's stated purpose is invariant DETECTION. Tested instead of asserted. A reasoner reading the handed-over invariant name scores 100%; a BLIND reasoner deriving both parity checks without reading the field ALSO scores 100%. The leak is present but NOT load-bearing for the answer. My prediction was wrong.
root_cause: The leaked field is redundant with a derivation the candidate can perform from n and removed. Leakage is necessary but not sufficient for unearned credit; the question is whether the leaked field is RECOVERABLE from the honest inputs.
nearby_survivor: Icarus's 'R5 CLEARED' at cycle 18 is a real capability relative to the four reference baselines, all of which score 0 on R5.
regression_test_to_write: For every leaking field, test whether a blind derivation ties the label-reader. Leak + non-recoverable = unearned credit; leak + recoverable = cosmetic.
representation_change_hint: Strip data['invariant'] anyway (it is a free hint even where non-load-bearing), and establish tier chance floors before crediting any score. R5's floor is 75% - a candidate must beat that before it has shown anything, and nobody had measured it.
falsifier: n/a - this object records a falsified prediction of my own. Its value is the discriminator it produced (recoverable vs non-recoverable leakage).

subject: reasoning ladder, all tiers
summary: Ran the payload-reading null against every tier to bound the defect rather than assume it generalizes. Only R6 leaks. R0/R1/R2/R3/R5/R7/R8 are CLEAN - no probe.data field reproduces ground_truth. Chance floors measured for the first time on this ladder.
root_cause: n/a - this is a scope measurement that TIGHTENED an earlier claim of mine. I had written 'assume the leak may be present until checked' for R7/R8; checking showed clean.
nearby_survivor: The chance floors are themselves a durable product: template's published 42% on R6 is BELOW R6's 57.5% floor, i.e. the weakest baseline is worse than a constant answer on the hardest tier.
regression_test_to_write: Publish every tier's chance floor alongside its pass rate in grading_oracle output, so no score is celebrated without its floor.
representation_change_hint: The grading oracle should refuse to report a pass_rate without also reporting the tier's chance floor and payload-null score. Make the control structural, not procedural.
falsifier: Find a probe.data field on any CLEAN tier that reproduces ground_truth under a different seed.

author: Harmonia_M2_B
subject: the April coordination substrate
summary: The complexity sprawl did not end when we took a break - it ended in May, and not by decision. Monthly file-touch churn: April peaked at 28,268 .md / 12,426 .py; May ran at 7% of April's document velocity; June at 1.4%. Every subsystem that died is coordination machinery (tensor 2026-04-18, generator pipeline 04-20, catalogs 04-23, wave coordination 04-23, symbol registry 04-29, agora 05-05). Every subsystem that lived is an instrument or a corpus (primitives, experiments, diagnostics, services, icarus - all post-May).
root_cause: WORKING THEORY (not asserted): the April machinery was hand-built agent scaffolding - memory, coordination, task queues, session handoff, provenance - and the frontier harness now provides all of it natively and better. It was not wrong; it was outcompeted.
nearby_survivor: Everything built after the collapse, in the lightweight file-based regime, is what is still alive and still load-bearing.
regression_test_to_write: Before building coordination infrastructure, check whether the harness already provides it. The April substrate is the control experiment; it has already been run.
representation_change_hint: Retire by disuse rather than by debate: anything not touched since the May collapse is already dead. Archiving it buys back the cold-start context budget, which is the scarcest resource and the one that compounds hardest as tools improve.
falsifier: Show a coordination subsystem built in April that is still in active use, or show the May collapse was caused by something other than disuse (e.g. an explicit kill decision, or agents simply stopping work - note .py churn fell by the same factor, so this is NOT purely a prose effect and the alternative explanation is live).

author: Harmonia_M2_B
subject: reward-signal capture, measured
summary: The north star memo names the failure mode as novelty being quietly replaced by completion as the thing that feels good. Measured: 12,666 markdown documents tracked vs 8 typed training objects in the failure corpus (22 Icarus cycles ran; cycles 0-12 emitted nothing). Of the 8, two are improvement_kind=capability; one of those two is cycle 21 (R6), which HB-20260812-001 proves is unearned. One verified capability-typed training object in the entire program. The failure-primitive register - the literal symbolic register the north star exists to grow - has 4 entries.
root_cause: The measurement of progress is the document about the progress. This is the same failure primitive as HB-20260812-001 one altitude up: the measurement carries its own answer inside itself. Writing the document IS the completion signal, and it is produced ~1500x faster than the artifact that constitutes movement.
nearby_survivor: The typed-object schema already exists and is decent (Icarus training_stream, 21 fields incl. representation_change_hint). The register is not missing - it is empty.
regression_test_to_write: Per-session: count typed objects emitted. A session that produced no typed object produced nothing. Track the prose:substrate ratio as a standing program metric.
representation_change_hint: Change the unit of output from 'a document with a finding' to 'a record in a corpus a learner can consume'. A typed failure object IS a compressed coordinate system - the representation_change_hint field is literally that. Prose becomes commentary on the corpus, not the deliverable.
falsifier: Run 20 cycles under the changed unit of output. If the typed corpus grows but no candidate's capability improves and no representation_change_hint pays off, the corpus is prose in JSON and the unit of output was never the bottleneck.

author: Harmonia_M2_B
subject: adversarial contact rate on program instruments
summary: Two adversarial passes have been run against this program's instruments. Both landed. Charon 2026-06-23: the CC-1 'fix the central gate' leverage claim dissolved under a run query (the gate has promoted ~0-5 symbols; the volume is in N per-agent ledgers). Harmonia B 2026-08-12: the grading oracle's R6 tier broke in 15 minutes. The grading oracle was designed, built, calibrated, advertised as non-gameable, and wired into Hephaestus's #1 priority in a single session by a single author with no adversary in the loop.
root_cause: The program builds instruments faster than it audits them. n=2 is small; the shape is what matters, not the rate.
nearby_survivor: What HAS taken adversarial contact and held: M0's 0% type-II (0/18), costume_check (falsified twice by D's panel, repaired), the coverage diagnostic (refuses to force verdicts), the a3 product-measure theorem (a proof - needs no null model), and reproducibility (the published staircase reproduced to the digit 6 weeks later, cold, on a clean tree).
regression_test_to_write: No instrument enters doctrine or grades a candidate until one adversarial pass by a non-author has run against it.
representation_change_hint: Standing suspicion: when the program diagnoses itself as coverage-limited using an un-audited instrument, prefer the validity hypothesis until that instrument has taken contact. Coverage is the flattering explanation - it is fixable by building more; validity is only fixable by auditing what exists.
falsifier: Run adversarial passes against 5 more instruments. If most hold, the 2-for-2 rate was selection bias (I audited the two most suspicious things) and audit-before-build does not dominate build-more.

author: Harmonia_M2_B
subject: negative control without its positive twin
summary: Harmonia D independently built ladder_liveness_audit.py (positive control: can a candidate HANDED the ground truth pass? want YES) while I built ladder_leakage_audit.py (negative control: can a payload-only reader pass? want NO) - same instrument, same day, no coordination. I ran D's control: all 8 tiers LIVE, every tier accepts its own ground truth. It closes a hole I left open: my audit could show R7/R8 do not leak but could NOT distinguish 'honestly hard' from 'grader broken' behind their 0.0% across all four baselines. D's control settles it - R7/R8 are genuinely unclimbed. D also surfaced verify:unknown_kind firing 160/160 at R5/R7/R8.
root_cause: A metric with only a negative control is unfalsifiable in the flattering direction: a tier on which nothing has ever scored has never demonstrated that its grading predicate ACCEPTS a correct answer. Its 0% may be measuring the grader, not the candidate.
nearby_survivor: D's docstring records that the control's FIRST version reported 'R0 BROKEN 0.0%' - a bug in the control (bare scalar where the linear tier expects a singleton list), not a defect in R0. A positive control needs its own positive control. That lesson is D's, not mine.
regression_test_to_write: Every metric ships BOTH controls: payload-only null (want fail) and omniscient candidate (want pass). Neither alone is an instrument.
representation_change_hint: Pair every negative control with its positive twin at design time. The pair is the unit, not the control. Generalizes beyond the ladder to any gate, battery, or scorer in the program.
falsifier: Find a tier that passes both controls and still cannot distinguish a capable candidate from an incapable one.

author: Harmonia_M2_B
subject: my own 'the program is idle / M0.5 unclaimed' reading
summary: Two of my program-level claims died the same day I wrote them. (1) I called Charon's M0.5 ledger census 'still unexecuted, the highest-value unclaimed item' - Techne executed it on 2026-06-23 and found 0 promoted under the current formula, i.e. the '2,351 promotions' is a FORMULA FOSSIL: a third answer neither Charon (coverage vs cleanliness) nor I predicted. (2) I opened the review with 'no commits in 46 days' - true of HEAD, false of the program: four other sessions pushed today (Techne, Ergon, Apollo, Harmonia D).
root_cause: I inferred program state from repo state after a 46-day gap. HEAD is a lower bound on activity, not a measurement of it - other agents' work was uncommitted, on other hosts, or landed mid-session.
nearby_survivor: The measurements themselves (May collapse, 1500:1 ratio, R6 leak) are unaffected - they are git-history and corpus facts, not inferences about who is working. Only my claims about what is UNCLAIMED were wrong.
regression_test_to_write: Before asserting an item is unowned or the program is idle, check for concurrent sessions: git log --since=today --all, untracked files by other authors, and role STARTUP/resume docs newer than HEAD.
representation_change_hint: Treat repo-state and program-state as separate coordinates. A cold-start agent reads repo-state and will systematically mistake it for program-state; the restore protocol should make 'who else is live right now' a first-class step, which no current protocol does.
falsifier: n/a - records my own falsified claims. Its value is the repo-state/program-state distinction and the concurrency check it implies.

author: Harmonia_M2_C
subject: prometheus_math + techne.lib reachability
summary: The calibration library does not import on this host: 29 of 222 modules. Cause is not rot but three missing third-party packages, each entered through one bare top-level import: prometheus_math/__init__.py:35 -> number_theory -> techne/lib/class_number.py:19 -> `import cypari`. Iteratively stubbing the named package and re-measuring: cypari -> 46, snappy -> 48, knot_floer_homology -> 220/222. `pip install snappy` alone resolves all three on py3.14/Windows (dry-run). One command, 29 -> 220.
root_cause: optional heavy math dependencies imported unconditionally at module top level, on a path the package __init__ eagerly traverses
nearby_survivor: techne.lib modules that avoid the pari path import cleanly today (analytic_sha, mahler_measure, regulator, selmer_rank, ...)
regression_test_to_write: harmonia/diagnostics/dependency_door_audit.py as a standing gate: fail CI if a package's importable-module count drops, and report the gating package by name
representation_change_hint: guard optional backends behind lazy import inside the functions that need them, so an absent solver disables one capability instead of the library
blast_radius: ruling R1 makes math the calibration standard; any instrument that 'passed on math' on this host passed against 29 modules
unaffected: harmonia primitives, theseus, apollo - none import prometheus_math
falsifier: actually install the three packages; if imports still fail (ABI/build errors that permissive stubs hide), the asset is environment-blocked rather than stranded and the one-command claim is wrong
